title: Take What It Guards
setup: Your rook on h7 rakes the whole seventh rank, straight through the black bishop to the king on c7.
hint: The rook on e6 has one guard. Look along the seventh rank and ask whether that guard is allowed to leave.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxe6}} simply wins a rook. The bishop on **d7** is the only defender, and your rook on **h7** pins it to the king on **c7** along the seventh rank. Capturing on e6 would expose the king, so the bishop cannot answer.
